source.title: [re:DEFINICIJA] dr. sc. Josipa Nemet: Suvremeni spolni odgoj je ideološki preodgoj djece (ep. 7)

summary.title_hr: [re:DEFINICIJA] dr. sc. Josipa Nemet: Suvremeni spolni odgoj je ideološki preodgoj djece (ep. 7)
summary.abstract_hr: U 7. epizodi podcasta Redefinicija gošća je dr. sc. Josipa Nemet, molekularna biologinja i majka petero djece, ujedno prva žena koja je gostovala u podcastu. Govori o kurikulumu zdravstvenog odgoja koji se kao izvannastavna aktivnost provodi u riječkim školama. Iz biološke i neurorazvojne perspektive tvrdi da kurikulum sadrži elemente rodne ideologije, naglašava spolni užitak i pristanak djeteta, površno obrađuje kontracepciju te zanemaruje ulogu roditelja. Predstavlja i svoj angažman u udruzi Članak 64, govori o krizi roditeljstva i važnosti granica i frustracije u odgoju te daje savjete kako s djecom razgovarati o seksualnosti. Zaključuje da je roditeljska budnost ključna za zaštitu djece.

key_points: Gošća navodi da je zdravstveni odgoj u Rijeci ušao u škole kao izvannastavna aktivnost kroz zakonsku mogućnost namijenjenu udrugama, iako međupredmetna tema Zdravlje u nacionalnom kurikulumu već pokriva spolno zdravlje.

Prema njezinoj analizi, kurikulum djeci daje neprimjerenu autonomiju nad objektivnom istinom, sugerira da spol i rod mogu biti različiti ili nikakvi te naglašava spolni užitak i pristanak, za što djeca neurobiološki nisu zrela jer nemaju razvijene regulatorne strukture mozga.

Tvrdi da kurikulum izostavlja odgodu spolnih odnosa do sposobnosti za trajnu i vjernu vezu, hitnu kontracepciju navodi kao kontracepcijsku metodu iako je smatra abortivnom, ne navodi štetne učinke kontracepcije, a pobačaj prikazuje kao jedno od rješenja bez upućivanja na savjetovanje s roditeljima.

Smatra da je suvremena psihologija nanijela štetu jer je zanemarila biologiju te da bibliografija kurikuluma sadrži samo jedan znanstveni rad, koji pokazuje tek porast znanja djece, a ne promjenu ponašanja.

Udruga Članak 64 nastala je iz inicijative Karte na stol i nazvana je po članku Ustava koji roditeljima jamči pravo odlučivanja o odgoju djece; udruga roditeljima pruža znanstvene informacije putem svoje web stranice i organizirala je konferenciju Bitka za djetinjstvo.

Ističe da je današnja kriza djetinjstva prvenstveno kriza roditeljstva te da djeci trebaju prisutnost roditelja, granice, dosada i blaga frustracija kako bi razvila samoregulaciju i sposobnost žrtve za druge.

Najvažnijim spolnim odgojem smatra odnos majke i oca koji dijete promatra od najranije dobi; roditelji trebaju odgovarati na pitanja koja dijete samo postavlja, a pri ulasku u spolnu zrelost pružiti informacije o fiziologiji i ljepoti komplementarnosti spolova.
key_points_en: The guest states that health education in Rijeka entered schools as an extracurricular activity through a legal provision intended for associations, even though the cross-curricular topic Health in the national curriculum already covers sexual health.

According to her analysis, the curriculum gives children inappropriate autonomy over objective truth, suggests that sex and gender can be different or nonexistent, and emphasizes sexual pleasure and consent, for which children are not neurobiologically mature because they do not have developed regulatory brain structures.

She claims that the curriculum omits the postponement of sexual intercourse until the capacity for a lasting and faithful relationship, lists emergency contraception as a contraceptive method even though she considers it abortifacient, does not mention the harmful effects of contraception, and portrays abortion as one of the solutions without directing toward consultation with parents.

She considers that contemporary psychology has caused harm because it neglected biology, and that the curriculum's bibliography contains only one scientific paper, which shows merely an increase in children's knowledge, not a change in behavior.

The association Članak 64 originated from the initiative Karte na stol and was named after the article of the Constitution that guarantees parents the right to decide on the upbringing of children; the association provides parents with scientific information through its website and organized the conference Bitka za djetinjstvo.

She points out that today's crisis of childhood is primarily a crisis of parenthood and that children need the presence of parents, boundaries, boredom, and mild frustration in order to develop self-regulation and the capacity for sacrifice for others.

She considers the most important sex education to be the relationship between the mother and father that the child observes from the earliest age; parents should answer the questions that the child asks on their own, and upon entering sexual maturity provide information about physiology and the beauty of the complementarity of the sexes.

summary.title_en: [re:DEFINICIJA] dr. sc. Josipa Nemet: Contemporary sex education is ideological re-education of children (ep. 7)
summary.abstract_en: In the 7th episode of the Redefinicija podcast, the guest is dr. sc. Josipa Nemet, a molecular biologist and mother of five children, as well as the first woman to guest on the podcast. She speaks about the health education curriculum being implemented as an extracurricular activity in Rijeka schools. From a biological and neurodevelopmental perspective, she asserts that the curriculum contains elements of gender ideology, emphasizes sexual pleasure and the consent of the child, treats contraception superficially, and neglects the role of parents. She also presents her involvement in the association Članak 64, speaks about the crisis of parenthood and the importance of boundaries and frustration in upbringing, and offers advice on how to talk to children about sexuality. She concludes that parental vigilance is key to protecting children.
